diagnosis: The route accepts collection_id from the path and dispatches a Celery background task using apply_async. It does not verify that the search collection belongs to the caller's tenant account, allowing any user to trigger resource-intensive reindexing loops against other tenants' Elasticsearch or OpenSearch clusters.
exploit_request:
POST /search/collections/coll_acme_prod/reindex HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
